RFSweepOutputSettings.description: Describes the settings for outputing data from an RF sweep.

out_file_name.description: Name of the file (with.csv extension) for saving the data-record.

metadata_file_name.description: Name of the metadata file (with.csv extension) for saving the data-record.

maxlen.description: Maximum length of the in memory data record.

minlen.description: Minimum length of the in memory data record.

columns.description: a list of every column for the datarecord.

plot_interval.description: How often to produce a short plot of whats in the active memory of the data-record (seconds).

short_plot_time_window.description: Time window (in seconds) for short plot made every plot_interval.
